cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It does. One question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.
